import os
p='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689779/attempts/75b9ca6211d4403aafd75899a9af5d34/system/state/workspace/programs/task-84d36b5f.py'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # Remove isolated marker cells; preserve contiguous colored rectangles.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import deque
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        col=grid[r][c]
        if col==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
        q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
        while q:
          y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
          for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            a,b=y+dy,x+dx
            if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and grid[a][b]==col and (a,b) not in seen:
              seen.add((a,b)); q.append((a,b))
        if len(comp)==1: out[r][c]=bg
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
